results.name: EuclideanDomain.mul_div_cancel'
results.source_text:
protected theorem mul_div_cancel' {a b : R} (hb : b ≠ 0) (hab : b ∣ a) : b * (a / b) = a := by
  rw [← mul_div_assoc _ hab, mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ hb]

results.name: EuclideanDomain.mul_div_mul_cancel
results.source_text:
theorem mul_div_mul_cancel {a b c : R} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hcb : c ∣ b) : a * b / (a * c) = b / c := by
  by_cases hc : c = 0; · simp [hc]
  refine eq_div_of_mul_eq_right hc (mul_left_cancel₀ ha ?_)
  rw [← mul_assoc, ← mul_div_assoc _ (by gcongr), mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ (mul_ne_zero ha hc)]

results.name: EuclideanDomain.toMulDivCancelClass
results.source_text:
instance (priority := 100) toMulDivCancelClass : MulDivCancelClass R where
  mul_div_cancel a b hb := by
    refine (eq_of_sub_eq_zero ?_).symm
    by_contra h
    have := mul_right_not_lt b h
    rw [sub_mul, mul_comm (_ / _), sub_eq_iff_eq_add'.2 (div_add_mod (a * b) b).symm] at this
    exact this (mod_lt _ hb)

results.name: EuclideanDomain.gcd
results.source_text:
/-- `gcd a b` is a (non-unique) element such that `gcd a b ∣ a` `gcd a b ∣ b`, and for
  any element `c` such that `c ∣ a` and `c ∣ b`, then `c ∣ gcd a b` -/
def gcd (a b : R) : R :=
  if a0 : a = 0 then b
  else
    have _ := mod_lt b a0
    gcd (b % a) a
termination_by a
results.docstring:
`gcd a b` is a (non-unique) element such that `gcd a b ∣ a` `gcd a b ∣ b`, and for
any element `c` such that `c ∣ a` and `c ∣ b`, then `c ∣ gcd a b`

results.name: EuclideanDomain.mul_div_assoc
results.source_text:
theorem mul_div_assoc (x : R) {y z : R} (h : z ∣ y) : x * y / z = x * (y / z) := by
  by_cases hz : z = 0
  · subst hz
    rw [div_zero, div_zero, mul_zero]
  rcases h with ⟨p, rfl⟩
  rw [mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ hz, mul_left_comm, mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ hz]

results.name: mul_left_cancel₀
results.source_text:
theorem mul_left_cancel₀ (ha : a ≠ 0) (h : a * b = a * c) : b = c :=
  IsLeftCancelMulZero.mul_left_cancel_of_ne_zero ha h

/-- A mixin for left cancellative multiplication. -/
@[mk_iff] class IsLeftCancelMul (G : Type u) [Mul G] : Prop where
  /-- Multiplication is left cancellative (i.e. left regular). -/
  protected mul_left_cancel (a : G) : IsLeftRegular a
results.docstring: A mixin for left cancellative multiplication.

results.name: IsLeftCancelMulZero
results.source_text:
/-- A mixin for left cancellative multiplication by nonzero elements. -/
@[mk_iff] class IsLeftCancelMulZero (M₀ : Type u) [Mul M₀] [Zero M₀] : Prop where
  /-- Multiplication by a nonzero element is left cancellative. -/
  protected mul_left_cancel_of_ne_zero : ∀ {a : M₀}, a ≠ 0 → IsLeftRegular a
results.docstring: A mixin for left cancellative multiplication by nonzero elements.

results.name: IsCancelMulZero
results.source_text:
/-- A mixin for cancellative multiplication by nonzero elements. -/
@[mk_iff] class IsCancelMulZero (M₀ : Type u) [Mul M₀] [Zero M₀] : Prop
  extends IsLeftCancelMulZero M₀, IsRightCancelMulZero M₀
results.docstring: A mixin for cancellative multiplication by nonzero elements.

results.name: mul_eq_mul_left_iff
results.source_text:
@[simp] lemma mul_eq_mul_left_iff : a * b = a * c ↔ b = c ∨ a = 0 := by
  by_cases ha : a = 0 <;> [simp only [ha, zero_mul, or_true]; simp [mul_right_inj', ha]]

results.name: EuclideanDomain.dvd_div_of_mul_dvd
results.source_text:
theorem dvd_div_of_mul_dvd {a b c : R} (h : a * b ∣ c) : b ∣ c / a := by
  rcases eq_or_ne a 0 with (rfl | ha)
  · simp only [div_zero, dvd_zero]
  rcases h with ⟨d, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨d, ?_⟩
  rw [mul_assoc, mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ ha]

results.name: EuclideanDomain.div_dvd_of_dvd
results.source_text:
theorem div_dvd_of_dvd {p q : R} (hpq : q ∣ p) : p / q ∣ p := by
  by_cases hq : q = 0
  · rw [hq, zero_dvd_iff] at hpq
    rw [hpq]
    exact dvd_zero _
  use q
  rw [mul_comm, ← EuclideanDomain.mul_div_assoc _ hpq, mul_comm, mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ hq]

results.name: EuclideanDomain.mul_div_mul_comm_of_dvd_dvd
results.source_text:
theorem mul_div_mul_comm_of_dvd_dvd {a b c d : R} (hac : c ∣ a) (hbd : d ∣ b) :
    a * b / (c * d) = a / c * (b / d) := by
  rcases eq_or_ne c 0 with (rfl | hc0); · simp
  rcases eq_or_ne d 0 with (rfl | hd0); · simp
  obtain ⟨k1, rfl⟩ := hac
  obtain ⟨k2, rfl⟩ := hbd
  rw [mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ hc0, mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ hd0, mul_mul_mul_comm,
    mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ (mul_ne_zero hc0 hd0)]

results.name: Physlib.PiTensorProduct.instAddCommMonoidElim_physlib
results.source_text:
/-- Given two maps `s1` and `s2` whose targets carry an instance of an additive commutative
  monoid, the target of the sum of these two maps also carry an instance thereof. -/
instance : (i : ι1 ⊕ ι2) → AddCommMonoid ((fun i => Sum.elim s1 s2 i) i) := fun i =>
  match i with
  | Sum.inl i => inst1 i
  | Sum.inr i => inst2 i
